quote: The operator of a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter shall not: Overtake and pass a motor vehicle unless the operator can do so safely without endangering himself or herself or the occupants of the motor vehicle.

activation.condition: Human operator of bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter overtakes and passes a motor vehicle.

obligation.description: Pass only if it can be done safely without endangering the operator or motor-vehicle occupants.

timing.description: Review original approach, alongside and pass or abort history.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original road and cycle/motor body history, relative motion and surface clearance require independent safety review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: without endangering himself or herself or the occupants of the motor vehicle
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original operator, motor occupant and passing motion evidence require independent endangerment review.
